seoTitle: Add a Video to Your eBay Listing from Your Phone
metaDescription: Learn how to record or upload a product video and add it to a new or existing eBay listing using your iPhone or mobile browser.
intro: Adding video to your eBay listings can boost buyer trust and show item condition more clearly than photos alone. This guide covers recording or uploading a product video, inserting it into a new or existing listing, and understanding eBay's video length and approval requirements.

steps.heading: Record or upload your video
steps.body: Use your iPhone or any mobile phone to capture a clear product video, or select an existing video file to upload.

steps.heading: Format it for eBay
steps.body: Make sure your video fits eBay's allowed length and file size limits before attempting to insert it into a listing.

steps.heading: Insert the video into a new listing
steps.body: When creating a listing through the eBay app or mobile browser, add the video alongside your photos so buyers can view it directly.

steps.heading: Add video to an existing listing
steps.body: You can also go back into a live listing and insert a video, following the same upload process as a new listing.

steps.heading: Wait for approval
steps.body: After uploading, eBay needs time to review and publish the video to your listing, so it won't appear instantly.

steps.heading: Replace or remove the video if needed
steps.body: If the video no longer represents the item accurately, you can remove or replace it at any time from the listing.

faq.question: Can I add video to an existing eBay listing, not just a new one?
faq.answer: Yes, you can insert a video into an existing listing using the same upload process as a new one.

faq.question: What kind of videos are allowed on eBay listings?
faq.answer: eBay allows product videos within specific length and file size limits, which are covered when uploading through the app or mobile browser.

faq.question: How long does it take for a video to appear on my listing?
faq.answer: Videos go through an approval process, so there's typically a wait before they're published and visible on your listing.

faq.question: Can I remove a video after adding it?
faq.answer: Yes, you can remove or replace a video on your listing at any time if it no longer fits your item.

faq.question: Which items benefit most from video?
faq.answer: Used items, collectibles, electronics, and fashion tend to benefit most since video can clarify condition and details better than photos.
